detail: 26 Rafale-M jets for INS Vikrant deck operations, part of a broader France-India defense agreement signed in 2025.
A long-range surface-to-air missile system; multiple regiments have been delivered, with remaining units pending amid sanctions-related delays.
Six conventional submarines with air-independent propulsion, to be built in India under a Strategic Partnership tie-up.
31 armed/ISR drones for the three services under a government-to-government Foreign Military Sales deal.
An indigenous fighter upgrade with AESA radar; deliveries to IAF squadrons are ramping up after earlier engine-supply delays.
A canisterised, shorter, lighter successor in the Agni series, undergoing induction into the Strategic Forces Command.
Attack and heavy-lift helicopters delivered to the Indian Army and Air Force under earlier Foreign Military Sales deals.
An indigenous BVR missile inducted on Su-30MKI and Tejas aircraft; a longer-range Astra Mk2 is in development.
Six Scorpene-class submarines built under technology transfer, with the final unit now commissioned.
A next-generation surface-to-air missile with a sealed-canister launch, an evolution of the earlier Akash system.
